articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev fires back at AMC's Aron in escalating fight over stock tokens
articles.snippet: Tenev told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Wednesday that public companies shouldn't have veto power over third-party securities that reference their shares.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
articles.snippet: Chinese-language platform Xinbi is accused of operating on crypto transactions as it offered services to other criminal networks.

articles.title: Consensys to split MetaMask into its own firm while staying silent on IPO
articles.snippet: The existing company, Consensys Software Inc., will rebrand as MetaMask under Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin as chairman and CEO.

articles.title: Kalshi election data goes live on DoubleZero ahead of U.S. midterms
articles.snippet: The expansion gives institutional and automated traders access to full-depth political prediction-market order books ahead of the U.S. midterms.

articles.title: TRM Labs doubles valuation to $2B in Series C expansion
articles.snippet: The blockchain intelligence firm said its annual recurring revenue has quadrupled over the past three years as it expands its AI-powered investigations business.
